why: This is a study-specific operationalisation of Biggs's 3P model for GenAI-supported assessment, not a general learning theory or a distinct theory beyond the source's contextual analytic framework.
The 3Ps Scaling-Up Framework is an implementation and dissemination framework for scaling a specific open-source physics-technology initiative, not a general theory of learning or teaching.
The 3P Framework is a setting-specific organizing model for designing one GTA-preparation program, not a general theory of learning or a reusable canonical framework.
This is a setting-specific five-hour laboratory-session structure for particular undergraduate and graduate optics learners, not a broadly reusable canonical pattern.
The 3P-6Cs framework is a QISE curriculum and program-design framework, not a general theory explaining how people learn.
name: 3P-6Cs curriculum framework adapted for QISE education
product_description: A curriculum-planning framework adapted by El-Adawy et al. for organizing quantum-information-science-and-engineering education across Personal, Program, and Practice levels, with six Program-level components.
